AgentTasks.Goal: Implement a complete FIDO2 / WebAuthn "assertion / authentication" server in Rust, using the **webauthn-rs** crate for all WebAuthn-specific logic (challenge generation, validation, assertion verification, COSE key handling, AuthenticatorData parsing, etc.). The server should expose two primary endpoints for user authentication: 1. `POST /webauthn/assertion/options` — to initiate authentication ceremony 2. `POST /webauthn/assertion/result` — to complete authentication ceremony Use the safe public API of webauthn-rs (not low-level core) with proper FIDO2 Alliance specification compliance. Implement robust security measures, proper error handling, and comprehensive test coverage. Do tasks one-by-one; after each task, wait for confirmation before proceeding.

SecurityRequirements.Requirement: Challenge Generation: Use cryptographically secure random challenges (minimum 32 bytes)
Origin Validation: Strict validation of request origins against configured allowed origins
Signature Verification: Proper ECDSA/EdDSA signature validation using stored public keys
Replay Protection: Challenge-response mechanism with time-based expiration (max 5 minutes)
User Verification: Support for both user verification required and preferred modes
Counter Validation: Authenticator counter anti-rollback protection
Transport Security: All endpoints must use HTTPS in production

TechStack.Storage: In-memory HashMap + persistent storage adapter interface
